Cycle103 produced actual raw-input initialized approximate H1 rows with branch/copy/add serving, but all tested unchanged-token response panels were zero.

Cycle104's contrast objective creates a nonzero contextual response, predominantly in the cube pair. It worsens the transfer endpoint errors and still produces zero vessel padding response. This is new evidence that objective and selected routing matter, not evidence of a general useful contextual transition.

currentRepresentation.observation: The implemented serving family owns raw-token/lexical initialization and predicts all512 H1 rows: two fixed-prefix cofactor rows plus510 learned rows. It branches on its own features and copies/adds shared constant writers with finite admission; original learned QKV operators are used as paid diagnostics, not its serving readout.
currentRepresentation.limits: This is a learned local program, not an exact algebraic compilation of the entire native function. The six histories are public/reused; the novel prompt has no native quality target. A complete own-state encoder/conditioner/denoiser/decoder loop and arbitrary-prompt images remain unestablished.

The two responding unchanged active positions9/34 yield pooled H1 error23.424%, with strongly unequal energy and opposite row trends.
observed104.adverse: Each vessel pair responds on only one unchanged row, global9, versus502 native nonzero rows. All475 unchanged padding rows have zero predicted response in all four ports. H1 pooled unchanged response error remains about99.3%; Q/K can exceed100%.
observed104.endpoints: Learned510 transfer H1 error increases from38.1074%/38.1815% for the prior endpoint writer to42.511%/42.589%. Relative to that prior writer, full512 rows are73 improve/437 regress/2 ties and70/440/2. The two ties are fixed cofactor rows.
observed104.localization: The selected tree uses causal means, current lexical coordinates and position. It does not use the available first/last ordered registers. After both color tokens occur, the selected mean features lose their order contrast; this concerns selected-feature sufficiency, not impossibility of the full155-feature family.
observed104.consumerCounterexample: Vessel row9 has H1 response error about4.743% with near-unit response cosine, but Q/K response errors about113.709%/111.317%. The two vessel pairs share the same prefix through9; the side edit is at13, so this repeated row is not independent transfer evidence.
observed104.attribution: A smooth RMS/projection Jacobian explains a possible base-geometry dependence, but is not an observed native finite-runtime Jacobian or causal separation. Exact consumer response error is e_B-e_A where e_i=f(C_i)-f(Y_i). H1 response accuracy alone does not fix either endpoint consumer error.

widerConnections.finding: A compact answer/readout law leaves the raw-input resolver, control and normalization computations unresolved. Future-sufficient coding requires both transition and readout closure; it does not follow from an answer table.

Toy quotient and restoration evidence separates a represented value from the state needed by future consumers. Small coordinate error and reduced-rank learned maps do not establish useful closed continuation; omitted orientation/history and restored carrier paths matter.

Own-state MLP feedback is scientifically relevant, but the inspected exact/selected SwiGLU execution still performs original F.linear and SiLU arithmetic. It is not a branch-only contextual constructor.

The ISA Boolean/copy program is an executable demonstration of future state updates from a supplied structured ABI. Its register/flag/instruction inputs and bounded window domain do not provide a raw-language contextual initializer or image decoder.

Read-role, baseline transport and curvature evidence supports structured conditional forecasts, with paid native bases/history/derivative or score preparation. It does not yet supply every operand from arbitrary own state without learned arithmetic.

The local reconstructed generator accepts raw prompt inputs but retains original learned execution/native encoding and decoding. The scoped notebook still distinguishes that from the bounded zero-neural chart. No inspected source supplies a complete zero-neural raw-prompt-to-pixels pipeline.

simplifyingQuestion.question: Can the already learned nine writer atoms carry the missing order-sensitive contextual innovation when the shared route is relaxed, or is the current finite dictionary itself the immediate limitation?
simplifyingQuestion.assumptionToTest: A reusable bounded family of consumer-relevant local innovations exists, with an economical own-input order-sensitive resolver. Cycle104 now provides a concrete finite dictionary and a concrete resolver failure with which to separate these two requirements.
simplifyingQuestion.loosen: Do not require eventual representations to reproduce every native H1 coordinate. Native H1 is the currently measurable interface, not the definition of image capability. Permit source-derived or learned discrete programs without a global equivalence proof during exploration.
simplifyingQuestion.tighten: For this diagnostic only, fix the dictionary, own slot0, finite admission, joint endpoint/response scoring and all histories/strata. Keep target-assisted capacity distinct from an executable target-free resolver and from native consumer utility.

decision.recommendedRoute: One fixed-nine-atom, joint finite endpoint/response capacity diagnostic before another fit or native-consumer crossover.
decision.whyThisChangesAction: The widespread missing vessel padding response is more consequential than the isolated row9 consumer discrepancy. Another routing fit would confound the resolver with the dictionary. A frozen capacity calculation asks whether rerouting alone could materially recover the missing response while retaining endpoints; its result changes whether routing work is justified.

contract.frozen: Keep the actual cycle104 nine slot1 atoms and exact own slot0 states. No new atoms, feature/depth/domain/teacher expansion, fitting, dictionary rescaling or native consumer/model call.
contract.soleRelaxation: Choose an atom independently per endpoint for this target-assisted diagnostic, relaxing only the shared routing constraint. Do not call the choice a serving program.
contract.finiteState: C_i(a)=finite_add(S_i,d_a), using the original slot0 source and the exact existing finite addition/FP32/BF16 admission policy.
contract.pairResidual: r_ij(a,b)=(C_j(b)-C_i(a))-(Y_j-Y_i), evaluated in the explicitly frozen FP64 operation order used for actual response metrics, not the relaxed q=P(Y-S) fitting surrogate.
contract.componentScore: For a disjoint pair(i,j), evaluate alpha_i||C_i(a)-Y_i||^2 + alpha_j||C_j(b)-Y_j||^2 + beta_ij||r_ij(a,b)||^2. The effective alpha/beta retain the declared endpoint/pair measures and frozen normalizers. An unpaired node has its endpoint term.
contract.enumeration: Nine choices per unpaired node;81 choices per disjoint paired component. Freeze scalar reduction, summation, tie order and finite checks. No search-budget or rank sweep.
contract.exactness: Mathematical separability gives the exact combinatorial minimum over the declared evaluated component scores. It is not an exact-real optimizer or a promise of bit-identical minimization under old global np.einsum reassociation. Rebuild and report historical pooled metrics separately.
contract.nonworseningScope: The current route is among the nine choices, so its component score cannot beat the enumerated minimum under the same evaluator. Individual endpoint/response terms or rows may worsen at the joint optimum; it need not beat cycle103's different dictionary.
contract.evidence: Retain current and diagnostic choices, ties, all rows/active/padding/cofactor scopes, endpoints, responses and signed joint tradeoffs. Target-assisted diagnostics on reused public transfer histories are labeled as such and do not select a hidden serving policy.
contract.interpretation: Useful joint capacity would motivate an order-sensitive own-input resolver under the fixed atom family. Poor capacity would stop assuming rerouting is sufficient, but would not exclude other dictionaries, consumer-relative representations or non-neural programs.
contract.consumerLimit: This is an H1 capacity floor under a relaxed route, not a native-QKV optimum, a depth4 realizability certificate, future-state closure, fresh generalization or a generated image.
contract.executionBoundary: Any later saved-array enumeration must be separately source/resource-qualified and use the scientific execution policy. Charge all finite state constructions, scores, reductions, source access and retention. This review neither implements nor queues it.

strongestAlternative.name: Exact finite native-base/own-response and own-base/native-response consumer crossover
strongestAlternative.value: Can separate base geometry and response-direction effects behind row9's accurate H1 response but adverse Q/K response.
strongestAlternative.whyNotFirst: It is narrower than the missing475-row vessel padding response and pays native consumer arithmetic without first establishing whether the current atoms can represent that response.
strongestAlternative.limits: Finite BF16 admission/reassociation controls and signed effects must remain. It is a diagnostic of the source consumer, not a target-free contextual producer. It remains a conditional alternative, not an automatic next job.

otherAlternatives: An order-sensitive raw-token register resolver is a concrete later candidate because first/last features exist but were unused. No hand-coded color/scene parser or automatic feature budget enlargement is justified by this review.

A different consumer-relative state representation is allowed and may ultimately be preferable to H1 reconstruction; no inspected source currently provides its complete economical initializer, update and image readout.

Full-vocabulary unary contextual tables or more dense-map/low-rank/derivative reductions retain costly or unresolved contextual dependencies. No fresh inspected evidence makes them the best immediate action.
Do not repeat a query-only/Hankel proof or fixed-prefix cofactor merely because it is easier. Those already establish useful boundaries without resolving content-dependent state propagation.
decision.gates: No quality threshold blocks scientific evidence collection. Only source/finite/schema/quarantine/custody/resource integrity may stop a future assay. Capacity and consumer scores remain heterogeneous observations, not success/failure gates.
decision.terminalStatus: Strict arbitrary-prompt zero-neural image generation remains unsolved.
